title: Expose current authoritative content without history replay
statement: The Definition storage Module shall expose the selected current definition and its recorded authoritative references directly from current engineering content, without requiring reconstruction from historical Changes or private conversations.

what.problem: A current definition spread only across change deltas cannot be independently understood.
what.desired_outcome: Presentation can access a self-contained current definition and the references it requires.

why.rationale: SR-004 requires current understanding to start from current authoritative information.

conditions: A reader requests the current definition after one or more engineering changes.

contexts: IF-001 retrieve_definition and retrieval of its required references in the same selected state.

how.approach: Return authoritative current content and references with explicit completeness, retaining state consistency across related retrievals.

how_much.scope: Required current definition context; optional history is additional explanation rather than a substitute source.

acceptance_criteria: A definition evolved through several Changes is retrievable with its authoritative references without reading or replaying those Changes.
Missing required current content or references is exposed as a limitation instead of reconstructed as an asserted current fact.
Optional historical material being absent does not itself make an otherwise complete current definition unavailable.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-004 for the proposed MOD-001 responsibility and IR-001 scenario walkthrough. Acceptance criteria are intended observations, not executed verification or an approval.
